messages:
Alex: Planning a traffic-drip for model-v7 this Thu 10:00 UTC. Goal: 0.5% -> 5% over ~4h, region-aware. Flag: `feature.toggle.model_v7`. Please confirm constraints and rollback steps. @Jamal @Lina

Maria: Sounds good. Recommend per-region caps: NA 5% max, EU 2% initial, APAC 0.5% (hold until basic metrics stable). Also suggest locking high-risk customers (enterprise accounts) to 0% until green.

Devon: Adding perf SLOs: p95 latency <= 180ms, error rate <= 0.3%. If breached, cutoff to 0% and route back to model-v6. Will make Grafana alerts for these.

Sophia: Agree with metrics. Add a canary QA guardrail: run small prompt set token-quality checks. If semantic regression > 1.5% we abort. I can hook evals to the alerting pipeline.

Jamal: Oncall here — if cutoff required, run `infra rollback --flag feature.toggle.model_v7 --to model-v6` and notify #incidents. I'll own the escalation and postmortem if we trigger.

Lina: Deploy plan notes: rollout window 4h, step sizes: 0.5% -> 1% -> 2% -> 3% -> 5%. Pause 30m between steps and watch the dashboards. I can trigger from Console or via `releases apply --slice=<percent>` if needed.

DeployBot: Scheduled: model-v7 traffic drip job queued for 2025-06-12T10:00:00Z. Initial slice 0.5% reserved.

Alex: Thanks — I'll update the runbook with exact thresholds and a minimal rollback playbook. @Devon @Sophia please confirm the alert query names and I'll wire them into the rollout job.

Devon: Confirmed. Grafana queries: `canary.latency.p95` and `canary.error.rate`. Alert if p95 > 180ms for 5m OR error.rate > 0.3% for 3m.

Sophia: Eval pipeline name: `evals/canary/basic-regression`. I'll add a webhook to post failures into this thread and to #eng-ml-alerts.

Alex: Perfect. If no objections I'll flip the flag to staged on Wed afternoon and schedule the drip. :thumbsup:
